name: Grow
overview: Scripture emphasizes spiritual growth as a process of being united and built together into a holy temple in the Lord, as described in Ephesians 2:21. Believers are called to grow up into Christ in all things by speaking the truth in love, recognizing Him as the head (Ephesians 4:15). Hebrews 5:12 highlights the necessity of maturing beyond foundational teachings, moving from spiritual milk to solid food, indicating the importance of progressing in understanding and faith.
